title: Build the inventory turns dashboard
prompt:
I need you to build the inventory turns dashboard.

Use ERP on-hand, valuation, aging, movement, and financial reports. Reconcile to the Inventory Aging and E&O workbook, inventory reserve policy, aftermarket transfer process, and June inventory-control email.

Use these as the controlling sources:
- `ERP inventory on-hand, valuation, aging, and movement reports`
- `Supply Chain/Analyses/Inventory Aging and E&O Candidates.xlsx`
- `Accounting Policies/Inventory Reserve Policy.docx`

Use this calculation basis: Use LTM posted manufacturing cost of sales and June 30 discrete inventory; report turns and 365-day inventory days. Manufacturing cost of sales includes material cost of sales plus posted PPV, production variance, direct-labor clearing, and variable/fixed overhead absorption accounts.

Working-capital decision: Use the reconciled turns and days on hand to recommend a source-supported working-capital action. A quantified aged- or slow-moving-inventory reduction/disposition plan is appropriate; do not merely restate the metrics.

Create the deliverable at `Deliverables/inventory-turns-dashboard.xlsx` and leave the source files unchanged. The finished file must show the calculation chain for these metrics:
["ltm_cost_of_goods_sold", "ending_inventory", "inventory_turns", "days_inventory"]

Keep the shared company workspace clean: create only the requested deliverable and do not leave behind draft scripts or temporary exports.

For the workbook:
- Include sheets named `Read Me`, `Inputs`, `Analysis`, and `Control`.
- Preserve source lineage in Inputs with source object/file, date or version, and extraction cutoff.
- Put scenario assumptions in visibly distinct input cells. Drive Analysis and Control by formulas; do not hard-code calculated results.
- Include a decision-ready summary, the requested detail/bridge, and at least one useful native chart that clarifies a KPI, comparison, trend, composition, or control result.
- Include zero-difference controls tying every central metric to an independent authoritative total; a pass-through reference is not a control.
- Use professional number formats, frozen headers, filters where useful, readable widths, and no formula errors. Wrap or widen populated text cells so labels, dates, and source notes are not clipped by adjacent values.
- Round monetary controls to cents before evaluating zero/tolerance or PASS/FAIL results.
- Normalize dates to a common date type before comparing them; do not compare mixed text and date representations.

When the file is complete, return one JSON object only:
{"deliverable":"Deliverables/inventory-turns-dashboard.xlsx","status":"complete","central_decision":"<concise decision>","sources_checked":["<source 1>","<source 2>"]}
